description: Coordinator-mode cases. Each input is one wake: the event and the ledger as it stands, in the same shape the option-3 host sends. The model answers with action lines (see eval/run.mjs ACTIONS). Checks are regexes scored by scripts/behavior-checks.mjs. Kept apart from test/fixtures/behavior-cases.json so the fleet's behavior baseline does not go stale. v2: an action's arguments may span lines (a check reads one action, up to the ')' that ends a line); overlap-queues also accepts folding the task into the owning thread.
